# Jacob Bowerman

> Full stack developer, creative, and ocean wanderer based in Sydney, Australia.

Jacob Bowerman is a full stack engineer who builds web applications and digital experiences. He runs Bowerman Digital, a web studio and dev agency, and creates projects across diving, accessibility, and personal web development.

## Projects

- [Bowerman Digital](https://bowermandigital.com/): Web studio and dev agency
- [Vizzbud](https://vizzbud.com): Scuba divers paradise - a platform for the diving community
- [Evie Bowerman](https://eviebowerman.com): Personal site build
- [TDAC](https://thatdisabilityadventurecompany.com.au/): Disability adventure company
